literal.prompt: Под каким названием Atari выпустила в 1977 году консоль, позднее переименованную в Atari 2600?

literalGroups.primaryGround: Atari history identifies VCS as Video Computer System and says it was later renamed Atari 2600; the Strong finding aid independently describes the Video Computer System and its rebranding. Lines under the 1977 heading say Atari released the system in 1977.
literalGroups.locator: Atari History L396, L398-L409; The Strong finding aid P2 L91-L92.

literalGroups.literal: Исходное название консоли — Video Computer System, или VCS. История Atari связывает VCS с последующим переименованием в Atari 2600. При запуске системы Atari подготовила для неё девять игр.
literalGroups.primaryGround: Atari lines 396 and 398-409 support the VCS expansion, later Atari 2600 name, release year and nine launch games. The Strong finding aid independently supports the VCS/2600 name relation.
literalGroups.locator: Atari History L396, L398-L409; The Strong finding aid P2 L91-L92.

literalGroups.literal: В 1982 году Atari выпустила более мощную домашнюю систему 5200 SuperSystem.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The Strong finding aid states Atari released the higher-end Atari 5200 SuperSystem in 1982 as a more powerful home gaming machine.
literalGroups.locator: The Strong finding aid P2 L97-L98.

literalGroups.literal: При запуске VCS в 1977 году Atari подготовила для системы девять игр.
literalGroups.primaryGround: Atari says its 1977 VCS launch included nine games; this is an additional, option-specific launch fact beyond the prompt and answer.

literalGroups.literal: Atari 7800 ProSystem вышла в 1986 году после 5200 SuperSystem.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The Strong finding aid says the 7800 ProSystem hit store shelves in 1986 after the Atari 5200 release.
literalGroups.locator: The Strong finding aid P2 L98-L100.

literalGroups.literal: В 1975 году Atari создала домашнюю версию Pong, проданную под названием Home Pong.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The Strong finding aid states Atari created a home version of Pong in 1975, marketed as Home Pong, and sold it through Sears.
literalGroups.locator: The Strong finding aid P2 L89-L90.
